nabd-masr.name: Nabd Masr
nabd-masr.summary: An Arabic news app that shows live Egyptian news by category.
nabd-masr.challenge: The news API often failed or returned empty results for Arabic categories.
nabd-masr.did: I designed a "Smart Query" with boolean search logic on a broader search endpoint, so each Arabic category returns accurate results instead of errors.
nabd-masr.note: The live demo is offline: the news API's free plan only accepts requests from localhost, and my attempts to proxy it in production didn't work. The code and screenshots are on GitHub.
built: Responsive Arabic news feed for Egypt using NewsAPI, with category filtering, search and pagination.
A "Smart Query" strategy with boolean search logic that removed recurring HTTP 500 errors and empty results.
Skeleton loading states, a 500ms search debounce, fallback images, and clear error screens for network failures and API rate limits.

around-the-world.name: Around The World
around-the-world.summary: An explorer for 250+ countries, with details for each country and its neighbors.
around-the-world.challenge: Clicking a neighboring country sometimes opened the wrong one.
around-the-world.did: I switched from matching by name to unique country codes (cca3), and refactored state handling to remove loading flicker.
built: Responsive explorer for 250+ countries using the REST Countries API, with strict TypeScript types for nested API data.
API responses cached in Local Storage to avoid repeated network requests for returning users.

notenest.name: NoteNest
notenest.summary: A notes API: create, read, update and delete notes, saved in a database.
built: RESTful API with Node.js and Express.js providing full CRUD operations, with data stored in MongoDB through Mongoose models.
Custom middleware and centralized error handling for consistent error responses, tested with Postman.

forsa.name: Forsa
forsa.summary: A job board web app built with Next.js, where candidates browse jobs and apply.
forsa.note: I'm learning Next.js by building this project, so it changes often.
building: Job listings and job detail pages (done).
Applying to jobs, an admin dashboard to manage postings, and sign-in with role-based access, backed by a database.
Later: an AI feature that estimates how well a candidate fits each job.

kanban.name: Kanban Board
kanban.summary: A task board where you add, edit and move tasks between columns, with light and dark themes.
built: Responsive, accessible task board built from a Frontend Mentor design, with task state managed in Redux Toolkit.
Pre-filled edit forms, status selection to move tasks, and a light/dark theme driven by CSS variables.

caltrack.name: CalTrack
caltrack.summary: A calorie tracker with a form that reacts to your input in real time.
built: Multi-condition form state and real-time input handled with useReducer and strict TypeScript types.
Client-side routing with React Router and component-scoped CSS Modules to prevent style conflicts.

portfolio.name: This portfolio
portfolio.summary: The site you're on: bilingual (English and Arabic), accessible, with a contact form that reaches me by email and Telegram.
built: Next.js App Router with full English and Arabic support, including right-to-left layout.
Interactive SVG star system and skill constellation, each with an accessible list view.
Contact API route with validation, rate limiting and spam protection, tested with Vitest and Playwright.

log.label: LOG 01
log.text: I studied Information Systems at Port Said University (2021 to 2025). My graduation project was HomeTech, a platform for household services such as plumbing, electrical work, carpentry and maintenance. I worked on the frontend, in vanilla JavaScript.

log.label: LOG 02
